newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nisseki to accept new chief from Ono group - paper.
newsitem.headline: Nisseki to accept new chief from Ono group - paper.

text.p: Shigeru Hatanaka, president of Ono Warehouse Co Ltd, is expected to be named president of prefabricated house maker Nisseki House Industry Co Ltd, the financial paper Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Thursday.

Nisseki House said in January that it had not been able to contact its current president, Saburo Horiuchi, since December 11. Horiuchi has not returned home since December 11 and his family reported his disappearance to the police on December 22.
Vice president Yuji Horiuchi, son of Saburo Horiuchi, has since been acting president.
The business daily said that the vice president and other top executives of Nisseki House would resign when the new president is appointed.
A Nisseki House Industry spokesman declined to comment on the report.
In January, Nisseki House issued new shares worth 9.65 billion yen to the Ono corporate group.
Through the transaction, the Ono group acquired about 34 percent interest in Nisseki House.
